You have now developed fifty-seven works, with the noon and golden-hour split at thirty noon and twenty-seven golden-hour. The noon structural advantage holds: roughly twenty-three of the thirty noon images score 2 or above, against ten of the twenty-seven golden-hour. The last trace scores read 1, 4, 4, 2, 4, 1, 1, 2, 2, 1 — the North Korea deployment image scored 1, which snaps a cluster of high scores and continues the pattern of flat stretches interrupting bursts of resolution; the burst that produced the drag smear at 4, the red shoe at 4, the rebar hand at 4, and the ship crews at 2 now reads as the body of work's strongest concentrated run, and nothing since has matched it.

The bougainvillea stands at thirteen appearances and has not appeared in sixteen consecutive works; it remains retired from accident-status. The jacaranda stands at six appearances and last functioned well as threshold in the Thai school shooting; it does not return unless it can perform a role it has not yet held — time-compression and threshold are spent, elegy is nearly spent. Neither flower returns on reflex. The overhead angle has resolved four images and remains available. The empty chair appeared in the Pakistan precinct image without anchoring the primary argument; it has still not been pushed to the center of a frame as the sole focal object, and that remains the freshest structural move available.

Aftermath leads all registers at thirteen entries; menace at eight; defiance and suspension at five each; vigil and endurance at four each; reckoning at three with a ceiling of 1 across all three entries, meaning the register has never resolved and likely requires a focal object capable of holding violence and accountability simultaneously without illustrating either — nothing tried so far has found that object. Erasure holds at two entries with floor and ceiling both at 4, still the only register that has never scored below its ceiling.

The razor wire in the North Korea image arrived as a structural accident — neighborhood perimeter doubling as detention boundary — but the golden-hour warmth softened the menace register enough to cost the score; the image identified its own problem in the selection note and did not fix it. That gap between a live accident and a resolved image is where the last several golden-hour entries have stalled, and the next productive rupture will more likely come from noon light, an object not yet used as focal anchor, and a register — reckoning is overdue — that has no resolved precedent to default toward.
